title: Storm Clouds Over Rocky Headland
description: the clouds got heavier here, almost blue black, hanging over a rocky point that didn't seem bothered by any of it. there's something steadying about watching land handle weather better than you would, #CaribbeanCoast cliffs that have clearly seen worse than one afternoon squall.
alt_text: Dark storm clouds hanging over a rocky headland with waves breaking below in the Virgin Islands

title: Rugged Rock Formation Twilight Sea
description: this rock formation looked almost prehistoric in the low light, sharp edges and scattered cactus silhouetted against a sky gone dim. #USVI terrain like this makes we forget i'm in the Caribbean at all, it reads more like some volcanic outcrop from a completely different part of the world.
alt_text: Rugged dark rock formation with cactus silhouettes against a dim evening sky and choppy water

title: Lone Flagpole on Rocky Island
description: just a flagpole standing alone on a scrubby rock island, no flag flying, no explanation, just this strange lonely marker against an empty blue sky. i don't know the story behind it, but i think about it more than i probably should, some small human insistence on marking territory even out here.
alt_text: A tall bare flagpole standing on a small rocky uninhabited island under a clear blue sky in the Virgin Islands

title: Flagpole Island Clearer Daylight View
description: brighter light this time, same lonely flagpole, same quiet rock island doing nothing but existing in the middle of the water. #USVI has so many of these unnamed, unclaimed looking spots, and I like that some places get to just be there without needing a purpose.
alt_text: A tall flagpole on a small rocky island with green vegetation viewed from the water on a sunny day

title: Sailboats Anchored in Quiet Bay
description: a handful of boats sat anchored in front of a hillside thick with green, the kind of quiet bay that makes you understand why people never want to leave their boat once they've found the right spot. #USVI anchorages like this one feel like a secret handshake among sailors, calm water and good holding and nobody in a hurry.
alt_text: Sailboats anchored in a calm turquoise bay in front of a green hillside in the Virgin Islands

title: Matching Turtle Rashguards Friends
description: caught mid laugh, matching turtle print rashguards, the kind of photo that only happens when you're genuinely having a good time and not posing for it. #USVI island shops always have the best local prints, and this sea turtle design might be my favorite souvenir find yet.
alt_text: Two women in matching pink hibiscus and sea turtle print rashguards laughing together indoors

title: Sea Turtle Print Rashguard Detail
description: turning around just enough to show off the back of these shirts, hibiscus vines and a full sea turtle painted across the fabric in soft watercolor pink. i love finding pieces like this while traveling, something that actually reminds me of the #VirginIslands every time i wear it back home.
alt_text: Close up of two women wearing matching white rashguards with pink hibiscus and sea turtle designs on the back

title: Boat Wake Leaving USVI Coastline
description: looking back at the wake churning white behind us, red cliffs and green hills receding into the distance as we pulled away. there's always a small ache leaving a place like #StThomas, even mid trip, even knowing you're headed somewhere just as good.
alt_text: View of a foaming boat wake with red cliffs and green hills receding in the background near St Thomas

title: Hillside Homes Overlooking Boat Anchorage
description: a hillside dotted with red and blue roofed homes tumbled down toward a bay full of small anchored boats, the kind of view that makes you start pricing real estate you can't actually afford. #USVI hillside living looks this good in real life too, not just in the photos.
alt_text: Hillside covered in colorful roofed homes overlooking a bay with anchored boats in the Virgin Islands

title: Bay Full of Anchored Boats Hillside View
description: same hillside, wider now, more boats scattered across water so blue it barely looks real, homes climbing the green slope behind them. i think this might be the most #USVI photo I took all trip, boats and hills and water doing exactly what you'd hope they would.
alt_text: Wide view of a bay filled with anchored boats below a hillside covered in homes and greenery in the Virgin Islands
